questions.description: 在有序列表中二分查找目标值。
questions.code_template:
nums = [1, 3, 5, 7, 9]
target = 7
low, high = 0, len(nums) - 1
found = False
while low <= high:
    mid = (low + high) // 2
    if nums[mid] == target:
        found = True
        break
    elif nums[mid] < target:
        low = mid + 1
    else:
        high = mid - 1
print("Found:",___, "at index", mid)
questions.solution:
nums = [1, 3, 5, 7, 9]
target = 7
low, high = 0, len(nums) - 1
found = False
while low <= high:
    mid = (low + high) // 2
    if nums[mid] == target:
        found = True
        break
    elif nums[mid] < target:
        low = mid + 1
    else:
        high = mid - 1
print("Found:", found, "at index", mid)

questions.description: 用选择排序给列表排序。
用插入排序给列表排序。
questions.code_template:
nums = [9, 2, 7, 4]
for i in range(1, len(nums)):
    key = nums[i]
    j = i - 1
    while j >= 0 and nums[j] > key:
        nums[j + 1] = nums[j]
        j -= 1
    nums[j + 1] = key
print(___)
questions.solution:
nums = [9, 2, 7, 4]
for i in range(1, len(nums)):
    key = nums[i]
    j = i - 1
    while j >= 0 and nums[j] > key:
        nums[j + 1] = nums[j]
        j -= 1
    nums[j + 1] = key
print(nums)
